messages:
Priya (Security): FYI: We're mandating OAuth client secret rotation + PKCE for all internal apps and removing support for confidential clients that store long-lived client secrets. Enforcement date: 2026-05-10 00:00 UTC. Policy: https://redwood.internal/sec/oauth-hardening :rotating_light:
sec-bot: Policy published: oauth-hardening (v1.0) 2026-03-26. Enforcement: 2026-05-10.
Priya (Security): Why: long-lived client secrets increase blast radius if leaked. PKCE + short-lived client credentials reduce replay risk and improve auditability.
Omar (Auth): Action items per team (short):
  1) Inventory OAuth clients you own via auth-bot: `auth-bot list-clients --owner=@team`
  2) Rotate secrets to ephemeral flows: migrate to PKCE (public clients) or client_assertion (machine-to-machine) where possible.
  3) For remaining confidential clients, set TTL <= 7 days and enable automatic rotation using the auth service.
Zoe (Apps): Example quick migration for web apps (using PKCE):
```
# front-end: start auth request with PKCE
code_verifier=$(openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -d '=+/')
code_challenge=$(printf "%s" "$code_verifier" | openssl dgst -sha256 -binary | base64 | tr -d '=+/')
open "https://auth.redwood.internal/authorize?client_id=public-web&response_type=code&code_challenge=$code_challenge&code_challenge_method=S256&redirect_uri=..."
# back-end: exchange code without client_secret for public clients
POST /oauth/token { grant_type=authorization_code, code=..., code_verifier=... }
```
Marco (SRE): For machine clients using CI/CD: we'll support `rctl oauth exchange --client-id=infra-bot --ttl=1h --assertion=@jwt` that uses signed client_assertion (JWT) bound to a KMS key. Example snippet in CI:
```
# create signed client_assertion with KMS
rctl oauth sign-assertion --client=infra-bot --key=k8s://projects/redwood/... > assertion.jwt
curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.internal/oauth/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials -d client_id=infra-bot \
  -d client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer \
  -d client_assertion=@assertion.jwt
```
Lina (Mobile): Mobile SDK note: we'll publish updated SDKs that default to PKCE and ephemeral refresh flows. Teams using embedded client secrets in native apps must migrate by 2026-04-20 or their clients will be disabled.
Priya (Security): Deadlines: 2026-04-20 inventory & migration plan due; 2026-05-03 complete rotation for high-risk clients; 2026-05-10 enforcement.
ci-bot: Scan result: 48 clients with hardcoded secrets found in repos (top hits: experiments/*, mobile/*, infra/ci). We'll open PRs with remediation suggestions.
Omar (Auth): Tools we'll provide:
  - `auth-bot rotate-client --client=ID --mode=ephemeral` (rotates secret and prints short-lived token exchange commands)
  - `auth-bot audit-clients --org=team` (shows TTLs, last-rotation, usage patterns)
Priya (Security): Exemptions are possible but limited: must include business justification, compensating controls, and an expiry. Request via the security form by 2026-04-25. Exemptions auto-expire after 30 days and require reapproval.
Zoe (Apps): Any guidance for third-party SaaS integrations where we have OAuth apps (eg analytics vendors)?
Priya (Security): Those count too. For vendor-managed apps, rotate client secrets with the vendor and ensure redirect URIs are exact; prefer service-to-service JWT exchanges where the vendor supports it. Put vendor integrations in the vendor-auth register by 2026-04-10.
Marco (SRE): We'll run a canary that disables legacy confidential flow for non-exempt clients in staging on 2026-05-05, and run a 72h smoke before prod enforcement.
Omar (Auth): Audit & logging: token issuance events will include grant_type and client_id. We'll surface anomalous re-use or long-running tokens as alerts to sec@redwood.
Priya (Security): Migration checklist TL;DR: 1) run `auth-bot list-clients` 2) mark owners and file migration plan 3) migrate to PKCE or client_assertion 4) update CI and secrets managers to use automated rotation 5) confirm in-thread when done.
Zoe (Apps): I'll start wiring PKCE in public web and open PRs for mobile SDK patches.
Lina (Mobile): We'll bump SDK minor version and publish migration notes by 2026-03-29.
ci-bot: PRs created: experiments/remove-hardcoded-credentials #102, infra/ci-ephemeral-auth #88.
Priya (Security): Please ACK in-thread once you have an inventory or if you need assistance. Office hours: 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC in #eng-all. :lock:
auth-bot: Reminder scheduled: run `auth-bot audit-clients` before 2026-04-20.
